mission.title: House Call
mission.description: Hunt down a Cypherite gang and question Cryptos' old crewmates.

npc.say: It's okay, baby. They were just leaving, and they won't be coming back.
Hey! Who are you? Get the hell away from my wife!

Don't know what else I could tell you about Cryptos that you don't already know. He was an okay guy to work with as long as you didn't get him going on the Machines. Always up for jacking into the Matrix. Big on recruiting people, too; he was pretty good at that. Convincing. Yeah, he didn't get annoying until you had to listen to one of his rants for the umpteenth time. I guess he's the big celebrity and all now, though. Funny. Crazy old Cryptos.

phase.briefing:
*cough* Hey there, operative. You're probably wondering what's going on. Well, the leader of the commandos, an Exile known as the General, has agreed to help us in our battle against the Merovingian. He was really insistent, in fact. So the commandos are our allies now, and you'll treat them accordingly. We may even be working with them in future missions.
But right now, we need to find out more about those Cypherites. Their apparent leader, Veil, is still at large, and they're interfering more and more with our recruiting teams. In fact, they just gave one of them a pretty rough reception. Fortunately, we've been able to track this particular Cypherite gang, and now you get to go give them the business. And while you're at it, try to find out where their leader is.

enter.say: I've got redpill signals in there--probably Cypherites. Also picking up some network activity.

objective.text: Search the area for clues about Cypherites

done.say: Looks like they were downloading something they didn't want us to find. The file is lost, but I may be able to trace that address. Give me a minute here...

complete.say: I've been able to trace that address. I'll point you there once you get outside.

phase.briefing: You've got a possible Cypherite network address? Wow. Wow. Can you feel my excitement? No? That's because I don't care! I can't do anything with that! Get me something I can use! Get me Veil!

enter.say: That's the place the Cypherites you fought earlier were downloading from. I'm picking up redpills, a computer network, and an alarm system in there.

done.say: That takes care of all the bandanas around there.
I'm reading some encrypted data on that Cypherite's body. See what it is.

objective.text: Get the key disk from the Cypherite Network Hacker

done.say: That's an encrypted key disk. They've probably got a computer system around there that requires the disk for access. See what you can find.

objective.text: Use the key disk on the computer

done.say: Bingo! You've gained access to that computer. Now try searching it.
Cryptos? The street magician? It seems that the Cypherites are awfully concerned about him. We'd better report this to Anome.

phase.briefing:
Cryptos? That religious nut who pops out of boxes? Hmm... There was that operative who was saying something to Niobe the other day about Cryptos' speeches referring to bluepills...
So this was the only lead you got, huh? That's just great. Okay, fine; here's what we're gonna do.
As you ought to know by now, Cryptos used to be a Zion operative. I'm sending you to hit a Mega City resident database. You're gonna look up the whereabouts of these ex-crewmembers of Cryptos who've since "retired" from service to live like damned bluepills in the Matrix: Giuseppe Friesen, Debroah Pryes, Stanley Sheldon, Jayme Ravina, Sebastian Uris. Of course, if you're caught, Zion will disavow any knowledge, blah blah; you know the drill.

enter.say: The computer database should be in there. Ostensibly, it's just a customer database for a large retail corporation, but Zion has found that the Machines use it for tracking residents of the Mega City. You'll have to watch out for their security teams. Also...I'm reading a fairly complex network in there. It's possible that you'll have to access multiple computer terminals.

done.say: I'm scanning some encrypted code on that guard. Could be another computer key disk.

objective.text: Get the key disk from the Tactical Security guard

done.say: Yep, looks like a key disk. Try to find the computer that takes it.
Good. You can access that system now. See what you can find on it.
That's opened up an access door in a room nearby.
The far door is sealed shut. It's controlled by the terminal in that room.
The far door should be open now.
Only two out of five found; not a very good life expectancy for Cryptos' "retired" ex-buddies. I can track those two resident codes, though. Get back out on the street.

phase.briefing: Only two? Well, maybe Cryptos is doing these publicity stunts of his to meet new people. Sounds like it's time for you to pay a little house call to Debroah Pryes. See if she remembers anything about Cryptos that would connect him with the Cypherites.

enter.say: I've got two signals in there: a bluepill, and a redpill.

talk.say: Oh, you're with them, are you? Look, I've had enough of you people! Yes, I was in a crew with Cryptos, but I avoided him as much as I could. He was a pompous, conceited, self-righteous, grade-A jerk! Never happy with anything. I didn't like it there either, but I kept my trap shut, and got out quietly when the chance came. I hope I've seen the last of Cryptos, and Morpheus, and all associated "saviors." I don't need saving, got that? Now get out of my home!

done.say: Yikes! Well, you might as well skedaddle. Hopefully Cryptos' other old crewmate will have known him a little better.
Hey! Who are you? Get the hell away from my wife!
It's okay, baby. They were just leaving, and they won't be coming back.

phase.briefing: You'd better get something useful out of Sebastian Uris, operative. I don't have time to be giving missions to people who don't produce results.

enter.say: I've got just a single redpill signal in there.

talk.say: Cryptos? Hah, yeah, I was just watching his latest little stunt on the news. Let's see... He was hard to get along with--wanted everybody to see things his way. He could draw an audience when he ranted about the Machines, which he did a lot. I mean, we all hated the Machines back then, right, but why waste your breath yelling about them? I don't think he had many real friends... Oh, he did pal around with that Cypher guy a bit. You know, Morpheus' crewmember who later went nutso and got himself zapped? That was a while after I saw him and Cryptos hanging out, though.

done.say: Cryptos and Cypher? Did anyone else just get a little shiver? Anome's gonna want to hear this.

mission.finish:
Cypher. It all comes back to that stinking line-cutter, doesn't it? So Cryptos was buddy-buddy with the most infamous traitor in Zion's history. Why does this not surprise me? Cryptos. Cypher. This is starting to add up to something. We're going to have to see what other nasty little rabbits we can pull out of Cryptos' hat.
Later.
